query:
SELECT count(*) AS "n!" FROM (
                                   SELECT FROM svs.run_events e
                                   JOIN svs.runs r ON r.id = e.run_id
                                   WHERE svs.run_matches(r, $1)
                                     AND ($2::timestamptz IS NULL OR e.updated_at >= $2)
                                     AND e.updated_at < now() - make_interval(secs => $3)
                                   LIMIT $4) x
